Our mission

Bookaway is changing the way people travel and taking them to new places. Come aboard and help us make a real difference in the travel industry.

Core values

Our values are the heart and soul of our team, guiding our mission to make travel more accessible and enjoyable for all.

We are Innovators

We have a commitment to revolutionising the world of ground transportation by creating new tech to improve the lives of travelers around the world

Big on Culture

We are a group of travelers who believe that everyone in the world, regardless of their background, should have the opportunity to travel with peace of mind

Crystal Clear

We believe that transparency is essential to creating positive and lasting relationships with our team, customers, and partners

Data Driven

We love data and data based decisions, which allow us to bring new ideas and possibilities to countries that need them the most
